title: Retain glow-only focus feedback on slanted panels
context: The slanted case-study panels already use high-contrast glow and ellipse feedback for keyboard focus, so their additional outline is redundant.

tasks.title: Verify glow-only keyboard focus feedback
acceptance_criteria: A keyboard-focused slanted case-study link has no additional outline
Both decorative focus ellipses remain visible and the panel retains its high-contrast surface, border, and amber glow
End-to-end coverage and design documentation describe the glow-only focus treatment
